text: And discovering that the dead are hunting the living.
Hospitals overflow. Cars crash. Families turn against each other.
By midnight, the power is gone.
Then your phone receives one final emergency alert:
Outside, hundreds of zombies wander through the darkness.
It slowly turns toward the window.
So how did they find you?
You escape through the back and race toward an underground shelter.
For the first time in days, you can breathe.
Then you hear a sound beneath the floor.
On the wall, you notice a dark, wet handprint.
They’re coming from INSIDE the shelter.
“They’re not hunting you because they can hear you.”
“They’re hunting you because you’re already infected.”
